text: When Leo arrived at the eastern part of the village, he noticed it was quieter there compared to the plaza. A gentle breeze blew as the sun slowly began to set.
Beneath a large tree, an elderly man was carefully organizing old boxes and tools.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Are you Leo? You must be the one Mira was talking about.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Ahh, good. Mira was a bit worried since you're new here in Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Forgive me. There are rarely new faces around here, so it's easy to notice.
Leo noticed that although Mang Ben was quiet, he spoke gently and seemed accustomed to helping people in the village.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: She mentioned your map is missing. Is that right?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: It's quite normal for newcomers to get lost here. Many paths in the village look identical.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Good to hear, then. But if you ever need help, don't hesitate to ask.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Do you know how to sign yet, Leo?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's a good start. What matters most is that you keep learning.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's alright. Everyone starts with nothing. You'll learn step by step.
As Leo listened to Mang Ben, he felt himself gradually growing comfortable in the village of Luntian.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: If you'd like, I can accompany you to the plaza tomorrow. There's a lot you can learn there.
The sky slowly darkened as a peaceful night settled over the village of Luntian.
